description.en: Download magnet links and .torrent files with librqbit.
description.zh: 使用 librqbit 下载磁力链接和 .torrent 种子。

label.zh: 通过 DHT 查找节点

help.en: Allow a compatible router to open an incoming peer port while the worker is running.
help.zh: 插件运行期间，允许支持 UPnP 的路由器开放一个用于连接节点的入站端口。

help.en: Leave empty to use OnesDM's download thread setting. The engine supports up to 128 peers per task.
help.zh: 留空时采用 OnesDM 的下载线程数。每个种子任务最多连接 128 个节点。

help.en: 0 means unlimited. Applies during both downloading and seeding.
help.zh: 填 0 表示不限速。下载和做种时都生效。

help.en: Optional filename regular expression. A file selection takes precedence.
help.zh: 可填写文件名正则表达式。勾选的文件优先于正则筛选。

description.en: Download a magnet link or .torrent file through OnesDM. Thread count controls the maximum simultaneous peer connections.
description.zh: 通过 OnesDM 下载磁力链接或 .torrent 种子。线程数控制同时连接的节点上限。
